Forest plot of effect sizes

Source: R/plots.R
cr_plot_effect_sizes.Rd

Forest plot of effect sizes

Usage

cr_plot_effect_sizes(results, method = "cohens_d")

Arguments

results

A single cr_result, a list of cr_results (from cr_test_all()) or a precomputed tibble with columns treatment, method, estimate, ci_low, ci_high.

method

Effect-size method to plot (default "cohens_d").

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Examples

# \donttest{
exp <- cr_example_experiment(seed = 1, n_cells_per_well = 20)
all_res <- cr_test_all(exp, "marker_1", "Untreated", level = "replicate")
cr_plot_effect_sizes(all_res)

# }
